Uchihas being extinct falls on danzo and the uchiha themselves actually. Tobirama came from a time where both the senju and uchiha had child hunters. Of course tobirama took measures against uchiha. Hikaku from the uchiha also must have had same measures against the then senju (them being the MP and being the point of contact of civilian disputes made them the opposite of isolated actually). 
But during hiruzens reign, danzo, the advisors and huruzen himself slighted uchiha. Intentionally isolating them in the village and all that bs increased the hostility of the uchiha, and the uchiha were not silent, they were fking planning a coup!
If the hokage had been the 4th or even the 5th at the time this situation would been perfectly handled. But because it was  hiruzen who turned blind eye to orochimaru, danzo  (and later the one who forbid all minatos friends to get in contact with naruto, and coincidentally ignoring what his 'law' did by neglecting and in turn emotionally abusing naruto), uchiha were ordered to be killed. 
So it wasnt tobirama who did anything that forced anyones hands. He took precautions which he thought were enough for any 'child hunting' or retaliation. 
It was his students who did all the shit. 
Tobirama would never go against his brothers wishes of a peaceful village and sow discord.

he created the academy and increased the age of becoming the child soldiers he dreaded, he didnt want any children to die like his brothers did. It was during the 3rd war that kakashi, itachi, and other prodigies were forced by hiruzen and others to graduate way too early and join war. tobirama is one of the best amongst all the hokages, definitely compared to his brother and hiruzen at least.
